Supreme Court Extends Protection from Arrest for Journalist in Ayodhya Temple Case

The Supreme Court has extended the protection from arrest for journalist Abhishek Upadhyay in connection with a theft case related to the Ayodhya temple. The court has made this protection 'absolute'. Upadhyay had reported on allegations of theft concerning the temple.
